elements.content: NEW EMPLOYEE ONBOARDING GUIDE — TEST DOCUMENT
Employee onboarding begins before the first working day and continues through the employee's first month.
The manager, HR, IT, and the employee share responsibility for completing the onboarding activities and ensuring the employee has the information and access needed to work effectively.
Help a new employee understand the organization, team, role, workplace expectations, security responsibilities, and the systems required to perform their work.

HR handles employment documentation and policy orientation. IT provisions approved devices and accounts. The manager provides role context, introduces the team, assigns initial work, and schedules progress discussions.
Employees should receive only the systems and project resources required for their role. Access requests should follow the organization's approval process.

NEW EMPLOYEE FIRST 30 DAYS
1 Day
Complete HR documentation, collect laptop and access credentials, review security guidelines, meet the manager and immediate team_
Week 1
Complete mandatory training, understand team processes, review the employee handbook, configure development tools, and attend project orientation.
Weeks 2-3
Shadow team members, understand assigned responsibilities, review relevant project documentation, and complete a small starter task:
Week 4
Discuss progress with the manager; identify learning gaps, confirm responsibilities, and agree on goals for the next 60 days.
